messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager Alert (P1) — inference-serving errors affecting hosted-api prod clusters. Trigger: 03:12 UTC. Symptoms: increased 500s and grpc timeouts for text-generation endpoints. War room: https://warp.redwood/warroom/INC-20260315-01 (open). Paging: @eng-oncall, @runtime. Incident ID: INC-20260315-01

Emma Chen: I'm on-call, picking this up. Joining war room now.

Raj Patel: I'll be IC for initial response. @Emma can you scribe and keep a timeline?

Emma Chen: Yep — scribing. War room link works. Collecting first-touch logs and request ids.

Leo Brooks: Quick impact note: from metrics, ~12% of hosted text-gen requests are returning 500s over the last 6m. Embeddings look intermittently affected on larger batch sizes.

Incident Bot: Automated telemetry: spike in grpc timeouts originating from model-hosting nodes in us-west2; elevated CPU and OOM kills on a subset of pods. Suggest checking autoscaler and recent model ops.

Raj Patel: Ownership: Runtime team owns mitigation steps here. @Marta (runtime) — can you confirm actions? @Ben (infra) — please check for recent deploys and kernel-level failures.

Marta González: On it. Scaling up and rotating pool now. Running:
```bash
kubectl scale deploy inference-worker --replicas=28 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker -n prod
```
I'll also drain suspicious node gke-prod-12 for inspection.

Ben Kim: Checking deploy history + CI: no model or infra pushes in the last 30m. Looking at node logs for kernel crashes / oom events. Will post snippets.

Emma Chen: Paging confirmation sent to infra-ops channel. On-call handoff note: if paging rate doesn't decrease within 30m, escalate to SRE lead (page: +1-555-0102).

Raj Patel: Status page draft (please review and approve before publish):
```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some customers may see elevated 500 errors and increased latency on text-generation endpoints in us-west2.
ETA: Next update in 10 minutes.
Workaround: We are routing new requests to alternate region and scaling runtime. No data loss reported.
```

Leo Brooks: Suggest adding: "We have enabled fallback model variant (smaller size) for affected routes to reduce memory pressure; customers may see reduced throughput/latency improvements but semantic quality may be slightly lower."

Raj Patel: Good call. Adding fallback note. Customer notification draft below — please keep it concise and conservative: 
```
We are currently investigating an issue causing elevated 500 errors and timeouts for the Redwood hosted API in the US-West region. Our engineering teams are actively mitigating, including scaling runtime capacity and enabling model fallbacks to reduce error rates. We will provide updates within 10 minutes. If you are experiencing impact, please contact support@redwood.ai and include request IDs where possible.
```

Marta González: Scale + restart completed. Observability: error rate dropped from ~12% -> ~3% within 4 minutes after scaling. CPU pressure decreasing on affected pods. Continuing node inspection.

Ben Kim: Found repeated kernel OOM events on gke-prod-12 around 03:08 UTC. Killing hung worker processes and clearing /dev/shm on that node. Log snippet:
```
Mar 15 03:08:12 gke-prod-12 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 17342 (python) score 987 or sacrifice child
Mar 15 03:08:13 gke-prod-12 kubelet: Container runtime error: killed by OOM
```
This explains localized failures; will cordon and reprovision node.

Emma Chen: Internal comms checklist updated: timeline (scribe), RCA owner (assign after stabilization), customer comms owner = @Leo, postmortem assignee = runtime lead. Also note to capture token-level traces and sample prompts for evals.

Incident Bot: Reminder: when transitioning to monitoring, update status page from 'investigating' -> 'monitoring' and include short remediation summary. If resolved, mark 'resolved' with root cause and mitigation.

Raj Patel: Monitoring now. Metrics look stable, continuing to watch for 30m window. Next update in 10m or earlier if things change. Great response — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Emma Chen: I'll publish status page and the customer note once Raj approves the final wording. Leaving war room open for another 20m then handoff to post-incident follow-up.

Marta González: Node reprovision scheduled. Will follow up in infra ticket.

Ben Kim: Escalation path confirmed if flapping resumes. Notifying SRE lead proactively.

Raj Patel: Approved. Publish and set next update. Closing on-call actions: keep channel notified, record timeline, and collect logs for RCA.

Incident Bot: Incident INC-20260315-01 now in Monitoring (as of 03:22 UTC). If anyone observes regression, please reopen war room and escalate.
